introSection.heading: The Crystal Cruises All-Inclusive Experience
introSection.p1: Crystal Cruises offers an all-inclusive style of luxury cruising, with accommodation, dining, selected beverages, butler service, Wi-Fi and onboard gratuities included in its standard experience. However, not every restaurant, excursion, treatment or personal service is automatically covered by the cruise fare.
introSection.p2: The distinction matters when planning your budget. Some specialty restaurants have complimentary reservation limits, certain premium menu items cost extra, and shore excursions are generally charged separately on Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony.
introSection.p3: If you are comparing Crystal Serenity, Crystal Symphony or the upcoming Crystal Grace, this guide explains what you can expect to be included, what may cost extra, and how to evaluate overall luxury vacation value.

quickAnswer.title: Quick Answer: What Is Included on a Crystal Cruise?
quickAnswer.subtitle: Crystal covers core luxury elements in every fare, with select optional experiences billed separately.

items.title: Standard Cruise Inclusions
items.description: Your booked guest room or suite, European butler service in every category, most onboard restaurants, selected fine wines, champagne and spirits, non-alcoholic drinks, 24-hr in-suite dining, Standard Wi-Fi, onboard entertainment, and staff gratuities.

items.title: What Costs Extra
items.description: Shore excursions on Serenity and Symphony, Aurōra Spa and salon treatments, The Vintage Room private wine dinners, selected premium meat cuts (Kobe/Wagyu) at Beefbar, additional specialty dining reservations beyond complimentary allowances, and premium Wi-Fi.

items.title: Key Inclusions Caveats
items.description: Umi Uma by Chef Nobu and Osteria d'Ovidio have complimentary reservation limits (1 to 3 visits based on voyage length). Guests in Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse suites enjoy unlimited complimentary reservations.

inclusionsEditorial.title: Crystal Cruises: What Is Included at a Glance?
inclusionsEditorial.subtitle: Crystal Cruises operates with an ultra-luxury all-inclusive philosophy covering accommodation, dining, fine wines, butler service, Wi-Fi, and gratuities.

features.title: All-Suite Accommodation & Butler Service
features.description: Every stateroom and suite category across the fleet includes European butler care, 24-hour in-suite dining, Italian linens, and ocean views.

features.title: Open-Seating Fine Dining Venues
features.description: Waterside, Marketplace, and Trident Grill are completely complimentary with open seating, daily rotating menus, and sommelier wine pairings.

features.title: Specialty Dining Reservation Allowances
features.description: Umi Uma by Nobu and Osteria d'Ovidio include 1 to 3 complimentary reservations depending on voyage length (unlimited for penthouses).

features.title: Fine Wines, Champagne, Spirits & Coffees
features.description: Selected fine wines, Champagne, craft beers, cocktails, soft drinks, and barista espresso are poured freely shipwide with zero corkage fee.

features.title: Standard Satellite Wi-Fi & Crew Gratuities
features.description: Complimentary standard shipboard Wi-Fi and prepaid gratuities for housekeeping, bar, and restaurant staff are included in your base fare.

features.title: What Costs Extra / Optional Spending
features.description: Shore excursions, Aurōra Spa therapies, The Vintage Room private wine dinners, and premium streaming Wi-Fi are billed separately.

suitePricing.title: Is Accommodation & Butler Service Included?
intro: Your booked guest room or suite is included in the cruise fare. Crystal offers different accommodation categories, from single and double guest rooms to Aquamarine, Sapphire, and penthouse suites.
All guest rooms and suites include comfortable bedding, a dedicated living area, and European butler service. The precise layout, pressing, and laundry benefits depend on the category tier.

items.title: Crystal Penthouse & Junior Crystal Penthouse
paragraphs: The highest tier of luxury accommodation, offering up to 1,265 sq. ft. on Crystal Serenity and 909 sq. ft. on Crystal Symphony, featuring expansive wrap-around verandas, separate living and dining rooms, and marble bathrooms with jacuzzi tubs.

Guests receive unlimited complimentary reservations at Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio, course-by-course in-suite specialty dining served by their butler, daily afternoon canapés and caviar service, and generous complimentary garment pressing and laundry allowances.

highlight.title: Top Suite Privilege
highlight.text: Unlimited dining flexibility without reservation caps and full in-suite meal service course-by-course.

items.title: Sapphire Veranda Suite
paragraphs: Crystal's premier suite tier for couples who love private outdoor living, featuring generous forward or midship verandas, expansive living areas, and walk-in wardrobes.
Includes European butler assistance, unpacking and packing service, daily fresh fruit, a curated minibar with wine and spirits, and included pressing allowances.

highlight.title: Sweet Spot of Value
highlight.text: Balances expansive veranda living space with full butler privileges and complimentary garment care.

items.title: Aquamarine Veranda Suite
paragraphs: Thoughtfully appointed veranda suites designed for comfort and elegance, featuring sliding glass doors to your private balcony and generous seating areas.
Includes full butler service, luxury bath amenities, plush bathrobes and slippers, 24-hour in-suite room service, and standard dining reservation allowances.

highlight.title: Veranda Comfort
highlight.text: Delivers genuine veranda living with full shipboard inclusions at an accessible luxury price point.

items.title: Double & Single Guest Rooms
paragraphs: Refined ocean-view staterooms featuring large picture windows and generous living quarters. Solo staterooms are specifically configured for independent travelers without single supplements.
Remarkably, even entry-level guest rooms receive full butler care, twice-daily housekeeping, complimentary minibar water and soft drinks, and all shipboard dining access.

highlight.title: Solo & Entry Value
highlight.text: Rare in the cruise industry: full European butler service is included even in solo staterooms.

diningZigZag.title: Is Dining Included on Crystal Cruises?
diningZigZag.subtitle: Most onboard restaurants are complimentary, featuring master-chef collaborations, open-seating venues, and 24-hour in-suite butler service.

items.title: Waterside Main Restaurant
items.description: Waterside is Crystal's grand main restaurant, featuring sweeping ocean views, open seating for breakfast and dinner, and nightly changing menus crafted from fresh regional ingredients. Sommelier-paired fine wines and Champagne are poured freely throughout every meal service.
items.bestFor: Guests who value dining flexibility without set table assignments or rigid dining times.

items.title: Michelin-Caliber Collaborations: Umi Uma & Osteria d’Ovidio
items.description: Umi Uma brings Master Chef Nobuyuki Matsuhisa's legendary Japanese-Peruvian cuisine exclusively to sea, including his world-famous Black Cod with Miso and sashimi. Osteria d'Ovidio celebrates regional northern Italian gastronomy with handmade pasta dishes and rare truffles.
items.bestFor: Food connoisseurs who appreciate Michelin-level specialty dining at sea.

items.title: Casual Luxury: Beefbar, The Bistro & Trident Grill
items.description: Created by Riccardo Giraudi, Beefbar offers modern steakhouse dining with street-food appetizers and prime cuts. The Bistro serves barista specialty coffees, warm morning croissants, and evening charcuterie, while Trident Grill serves made-to-order poolside burgers, wraps, and fries throughout the afternoon.
items.bestFor: Relaxed afternoons, al fresco terrace breakfasts, and poolside lunches.

items.title: 24-Hour In-Suite Butler Dining & The Vintage Room
items.description: Enjoy complimentary 24-hour room service served course-by-course on your private veranda by your butler. For the ultimate culinary celebration, The Vintage Room hosts an intimate multi-course private dinner paired with rare, historic vintages from Crystal's cellar (extra fee).
items.bestFor: Private celebrations, veranda dinners under the stars, and rare wine enthusiasts.

reservationPolicyCards.title: Umi Uma & Osteria d’Ovidio Specialty Dining Reservation Policy
bestFor: Voyages up to 11 nights: 1 complimentary reservation per guest at each specialty restaurant
Voyages 12 to 22 nights: 2 complimentary reservations per guest at each specialty restaurant
Voyages 23 nights or more: 3 complimentary reservations per guest at each specialty restaurant
Crystal Penthouse & Junior Crystal Penthouse suites receive unlimited complimentary reservations
Children dining with parents are included under standard stateroom reservation allowances
notBestFor: Additional reservations beyond complimentary allowance carry a $75 per person charge
Reservations can be pre-booked in advance via Crystal's online Priority Planning Center
Subject to dining room availability and requested dining times (prime slots fill early)
Reservations reset on back-to-back voyage sectors, granting fresh complimentary allowances
Specialty wine-pairing dinners (such as The Vintage Room) carry separate cover charges
reservationPolicyCards.bottomNote: Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse guests enjoy unlimited complimentary specialty dining reservations without cover charges, subject to table availability.

onboardPerksBento.title: Selected Wines, Champagne & Spirits
onboardPerksBento.description: Selected fine wines, Champagne, craft beers, premium spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages are poured freely across all bars, restaurants, and in-suite minibars. Crystal also charges zero corkage fee if you bring your own favorite bottle onboard.

onboardPerksBento.title: Wi-Fi: Complimentary Standard vs. Paid Premium
onboardPerksBento.description: Complimentary Standard Wi-Fi is included for all guests for browsing and email. A paid Premium plan is available at $20 per day or $100 for a seven-day package for video streaming, calling, and multi-device priority.

onboardPerksBento.title: Gratuities for Housekeeping & Dining Crew
onboardPerksBento.description: Gratuities for onboard housekeeping, dining, and bar crew are included in Crystal's published cruise fare. Guests do not need to add compulsory daily tipping fees. Additional gratuities are entirely discretionary.

onboardPerksBento.title: Entertainment, Enrichment & Fitness Access
onboardPerksBento.description: Enjoy Broadway-style theatrical productions, cabaret shows, live classical concerts, guest speakers, destination talks, computer enrichment, golf driving nets, paddle tennis, and full access to the fitness center.

budgetRoadmap.title: How to Calculate the Real Cost of a Crystal Cruise
budgetRoadmap.subtitle: A practical 5-step framework to determine your complete luxury vacation investment.

steps.title: Start With Base Cruise Fare
steps.description: Multiply your chosen suite's per-person published fare by two (for double occupancy) or evaluate single-occupancy rates if traveling solo.

steps.title: Budget for Shore Excursions
steps.description: Because shore excursions are not included on Serenity and Symphony, budget approximately $150 to $350 per person per port day for curated tours or private guides.

steps.title: Factor In International Flights & Transfers
steps.description: Confirm whether your booking includes airfare or transfers. Budget for international business or economy flights and private port transfers.

steps.title: Plan Pre- and Post-Cruise Hotels
steps.description: Arriving a day or two before embarkation ensures a stress-free transition. Budget for 1–2 nights at luxury partner hotels in your departure port.

steps.title: Account for Optional Onboard Spending & Insurance
steps.description: Budget for Aurōra Spa treatments, The Vintage Room wine pairing dinners, premium streaming Wi-Fi ($100/week), and comprehensive travel protection.

faqs.question: What is included in a Crystal cruise fare?
faqs.answer: A Crystal cruise fare generally includes your booked accommodation, most onboard dining venues, selected wines and spirits, non-alcoholic beverages, 24-hour in-suite dining, butler service across every suite category, Standard Wi-Fi, onboard entertainment, and gratuities for housekeeping, dining, and bar staff. Specific inclusions depend on your booking terms and suite category.

faqs.question: Are all restaurants included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Most Crystal restaurants are complimentary, including Waterside, Marketplace, Trident Grill, The Bistro, and Scoops Gelato. The Vintage Room is chargeable, selected premium beef cuts at Beefbar cost extra, and Umi Uma by Nobu and Osteria d’Ovidio have complimentary reservation allowances based on voyage length.

faqs.question: Are drinks included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected fine wines, Champagne, spirits, craft beers, and non-alcoholic beverages (specialty coffees, teas, sodas, and bottled water) are included throughout the ship and in your in-suite minibar. Certain rare vintages and premium labels carry an additional charge.

faqs.question: Is room service included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Crystal offers complimentary 24-hour in-suite dining. Your butler will deliver and serve meals in your suite or private veranda course-by-course without any service fee. Additional specialty restaurant ordering depends on suite category privileges.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi free on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Standard Wi-Fi is complimentary for all guests for messaging, browsing, and email. A paid Premium Wi-Fi plan is available for $20 per day or $100 for a seven-day package for video streaming, conferencing, and multi-device priority.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Gratuities for onboard housekeeping, dining, and bar crew are included under Crystal's published fare policy. Guests do not need to add daily tips. Additional tipping for exceptional personal service is completely discretionary.

faqs.question: Is butler service included in every Crystal suite?
faqs.answer: Yes. European butler service is provided in all Crystal guest rooms and suites, from single staterooms to penthouses. Your butler assists with packing, reservations, garment pressing, shoe shine, and daily in-suite refreshments.

faqs.question: Are shore excursions included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Generally, no. Shore excursions on Crystal Serenity and Crystal Symphony are priced separately. This gives guests total freedom to explore independently, arrange private guides, or choose specific curated destination excursions.

faqs.question: Is the spa included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Access to the fitness facilities, pool deck, sauna, and steam room is generally included. Aurōra Spa treatments, massages, facials, salon services, and personal training sessions are charged separately.

faqs.question: Is laundry included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Complimentary self-service guest launderettes are available across passenger decks. Complimentary pressing, laundry, and dry cleaning allowances are included for select Aquamarine, Sapphire, and penthouse suite categories.

faqs.question: Does Crystal charge extra for Umi Uma and Osteria d’Ovidio?
faqs.answer: Most guests receive 1 to 3 complimentary reservations at each restaurant per voyage, depending on sailing length (1 for up to 11 nights, 2 for 12–22 nights, 3 for 23+ nights). Additional reservations beyond the allowance cost $75 per person. Crystal Penthouse and Junior Crystal Penthouse guests receive unlimited complimentary visits.

faqs.question: Does Beefbar cost extra on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: Beefbar is complimentary for lunch and dinner under Crystal's dining policy. Dinner reservations are required. However, selected ultra-premium meat cuts, such as rare Kobe and Wagyu beef selections, carry a surcharge on the menu.

faqs.question: Is The Vintage Room included on Crystal Cruises?
faqs.answer: No. The Vintage Room is an intimate, separately chargeable gourmet dining experience featuring custom multi-course dinners paired with rare vintage wines from the sommelier's private cellar.

faqs.question: Are flights and transfers included in Crystal cruise prices?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Flights, pre/post hotels, and airport transfers are optional and depend on the booking offer. Crystal offers optional air programs on select itineraries that may include transfers for eligible guests.

faqs.question: Are taxes and port charges included in the advertised Crystal cruise fare?
faqs.answer: The treatment of taxes, port expenses, and other mandatory charges depends on the fare and booking jurisdiction. Always review your complete written booking quote to confirm all included and payable amounts.

faqs.question: Is Crystal Cruises truly all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Crystal provides an exceptional all-inclusive onboard lifestyle covering suites, butler service, fine dining, drinks, Standard Wi-Fi, and gratuities. However, shore excursions, spa treatments, top-tier beef cuts, The Vintage Room, and premium streaming Wi-Fi are billed separately.
